03 / THE METHOD

A better question
than “who scored most?”

We value what a player did relative to what the situation demanded, using only information available before each ball.

01
◷

Read the moment

Phase, wickets already lost, balls remaining, chase requirement, and knockout context define pressure before the delivery.

02
⌁

Set a fair baseline

Earlier matches set expected runs and dismissals, pooled across sparse format, phase, venue and opponent contexts.

03
◎

Correct the context

A second model adjusts for pressure-state bias and captures early collapses and live middle-over chases more fully.

04
✦

Demand agreement

Players must clear exposure gates under both methods. We add conservative within-role ranks; the smallest sum wins.

THE DECISION RULE

Two definitions. One consensus. The final list balances the original pressure rule with a corrected state-aware view.

4,421powerplay deliveries flagged medium or high pressure by the state rule

The legacy rule flagged one medium-pressure powerplay ball and no high-pressure balls after scoring exclusions.

!

What this does not prove

Bowling results are mixed across years: consensus trails the legacy top ten in 2025 and the state top ten in 2026. Exact extras are unavailable for 259 eligible games, and T20I coverage is incomplete. Adjacent ranks are not certain.
